text:
incident-bot: AUTOPAGE fired -> PagerDuty: metrics-ingest-service (INC-12345). Reason: prometheus scrape job 'node-exporter' reporting missing metrics for ~45 targets, scrape failures rising from 2% -> 78% in last 5m. Autopage policy: fanout_threshold=10.
Alex: Acked in PD, I'm taking initial triage.
Maria: seeing repeated OOMKilled events in the exporter logs on node ip-10-1-5-3, k8s events show restartCount=4 for exporter-daemonset. Logs: `oom_kill` + `killed process 3124` around 10:14 UTC.
Kevin (oncall): Heads up my handoff in ~20m, if this needs a longer fix I'll take it after handoff.
Sam (customer-ops): FYI we have a couple support tickets about delayed alerts for EU customers since ~10:05 UTC. Not full outage but delayed signal.
Alex: quick checklist: 1) confirm which targets are missing 2) check node memory pressure 3) consider temporary silence to avoid pager thrash. Running `kubectl -n monitoring get pods -l app=node-exporter -o wide`.
Maria: output pasted: ```
NAME                                  READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE   NODE
node-exporter-ip-10-1-5-3             0/1     CrashLoop 4          2h   ip-10-1-5-3
node-exporter-ip-10-1-5-7             1/1     Running   0          2h   ip-10-1-5-7
```
Maria: tail of exporter stderr: ``[10:13:45] panic: runtime: out of memory
stack: runtime.systemstack...``, also `memory.available` on that node is <150Mi.
Alex: ok can we cordon the node and let k8s reschedule if needed? Maria, can you `kubectl cordon ip-10-1-5-3` and then restart the daemonset pod? I'll open a PD silence for 30m to avoid multiple autopages while we fix.
Maria: cordoned node and deleted the exporter pod `kubectl delete pod node-exporter-ip-10-1-5-3 -n monitoring` to force recreate on same node (we may want reschedule elsewhere). Pod came back but still OOMing -> likely node-level memory pressure.
pagerduty-bot: Silence applied: INC-12345 for 30m by Alex. Autopage suppressions enabled.
Kevin (oncall): Suggest temporary mitigation: reduce scrape frequency for heavy exporters to lower scrape fanout. We can patch prometheus scrape_config for the problematic job to `scrape_interval: 60s` from `15s` for the next 15m. That will reduce load while infra investigates node memory.
Alex: good plan. I'll push a short-lived patch to the monitoring kustomize and apply. Command: ``kubectl patch configmap prometheus-scrape-config -n monitoring --patch '{"data":{"scrape_configs.yaml":"..."}}'`` (will post exact patch in infra PR).
Sam (customer-ops): With the silence in place, customers won't get duplicate alerts but dashboard anomalies still visible; notify EU customers that we're investigating degraded metrics ingestion.
Maria: infra checked `dmesg` and found kernel OOM kills tied to a sidecar process on that node (non-exporter). Kubelet shows `eviction_threshold` hit, kubelet evicted exporter shortly after sidecar spike. Memory pressure root cause looks like a memory leak on sidecar service `log-enricher`.
Alex: Nice find. Next steps: 1) stop offending sidecar on node ip-10-1-5-3 (cordon + drain) 2) bump node allocatable temporarily or move heavy pods off 3) revert scrape_interval after stabilization.
Maria: drained node and deleted offending pods. After pods rescheduled, node memory stabilized and exporter pods are `1/1` running. No further OOMs in last 3 mins.
incident-bot: Autopage suppression will expire in ~25m; monitors still firing suppressed alerts for the service.
Alex: unsilenced PD early? Not yet. I'll keep the 30m silence to avoid churn. If things look green in 10m, I'll unsilence.
Kevin (oncall): I'll take the remainder of the incident since I'm up next. Assigning ops follow-ups: Maria -> memory profiling for log-enricher; Infra -> investigate node resource pressure trends and consider increasing node memory for that ASG; Alex -> roll back scrape interval patch and open a postmortem doc.
Sam (customer-ops): I'll update affected customers with ETA for full resolution and note that metrics ingestion is restored but we are doing root cause analysis.
Maria: monitoring: exporter scrape success rate back to 99% for affected targets. Pushing logs to the incident thread and starting a heap profile for log-enricher.
Alex: handoff complete, handing to Kevin — please ping me if PD starts firing again, will join on-call if needed. :thumbsup:
Kevin (oncall): Taking over, I'll open a ticket INC-12345-FUP and schedule a short blameless postmortem. Thanks all.
incident-bot: Thread closed for autopage notifications. Reminder: file postmortem in #postmortems and tag @infra, @monitoring, @sre on the follow-up.
Alex: adding final note: root cause likely memory leak in log-enricher causing node memory pressure -> kubelet evicted daemonset exporters -> Prometheus scrape fanout spike + autopage. Immediate mitigations: cordon/drain, silence, scrape interval bump, restart offending pod. Longer-term: profiling/fix + infra sizing.
Maria: I'll own the remediation PR with heap dump and fix plan.
Sam (customer-ops): I'll add customer communication to the ticket.
Kevin (oncall): Closing handoff.
